description: This file defines the interface ICatalogViewModelService which specifies methods for retrieving catalog items, brands, and types asynchronously in a web application related to an eShop project.

classes.name: ICatalogViewModelService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for accessing catalog data such as items, brands, and types asynchronously.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a paged list of catalog items filtered by brand and type.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available brands as select list items.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available product types as select list items.
